newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 28.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Bank of Japan and Finance Ministry ask major banks to provide 300 billion yen to NCB.
-- Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) proposes scrapping or privatising 11 public corporations.
-- Japan's population aged from 15 to 64 years old decreases for first time since end of the World War Two.
-- Health and Welfare Ministry bans use of imported dura mater believed possibly to cause Creutzfeldt Jakob disease.
-- Government will decide next week on revision of law for securing land for U.S. military in Okinawa.
-- Peruvian government to present list of the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) prisoners to be released.
-- Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori says hostage crisis in Lima in final stage.
